project.name: Faktori V1
project.progressSummary: Updated 2026-09-07. Phases 0–6 are accepted; Phase 7 remains unaccepted and unchanged. Owner-authorized concurrent Phase 8 implementation remains based on exact F7 candidate af958a28f8366e91683f3f67615cc2ec5ea0ee88. The first exact-head F8 candidate was not accepted; F8-03 remediation now adds an actual read-only installed-projection check and credential-safe diagnostic IDs. The advisory forecast progressed from 420,000 to 1,100,000 and then 1,700,000 tokens after measured goal telemetry and manager rework; it is not a cap. Specialist counters and parent-child inclusion remain unknown and are not added.

tickets.title: Establish the standalone project
notes: Public foundation, provider-neutral architecture, pinned Node 24/npm 12 toolchain, and complete Apache-2.0 license verified.

tickets.title: Implement construction tracking and token monitoring
notes: The phase orchestrator exclusively owns this canonical checklist; raw usage stays ignored and only sanitized overlap-safe summaries are committed.

tickets.title: Prove required provider mechanics
notes: Bounded native launch/resume feasibility is met. Authenticated isolated execution remains a hard later-phase gate; unavailable native permission and cancellation receipts remain unsupported capabilities with truthful outcome classification, not universal admission requirements.

tickets.title: Freeze comparison fixtures
notes: Luna-medium produced the initial fixture set; evidence-driven review escalated remediation to Terra-high. Frozen expected-RED and base-GREEN contracts now reproduce under Node 24; no benchmark runs were performed.

tickets.title: Build the configuration model
notes: Strict TypeScript runtime sources resolve factory, product, optional pod, provider, budget, authority, environment, capability, and sparse-override behavior; the package emits JavaScript and declarations and the packed CLI is verified from a clean install.

tickets.title: Implement interview and resumable provisioning
notes: Discover-first onboarding now maps every answer to actual retained configuration, discovery, proposal, or explicitly pending fields. A completed example proves valid resolution, answer retention, proposal creation, and stale-approval invalidation; revision-bound, resumable local provisioning remains verified and remote effects stay unsupported.

tickets.title: Implement hierarchy and context assembly
notes: Stable hierarchy identities, cycle and reference rejection, planning/executable separation, immutable ancestor constraints, dependency contracts, and source-revisioned scoped context packets are verified without unrelated sibling material.

tickets.title: Author lifecycle skills and provider wrappers

owner.role: skills, entry maps, and examples specialist

notes: Eleven concise skills, proportional lifecycle packaging, stack-neutral examples, and deterministic provider entry maps are verified. Bootstrap semantic tests now validate every interview destination against the actual retained configuration, discovery, proposal, and pending-field contract.

tickets.title: Implement coordinator and durable run records
notes: Append-only JSONL is authoritative; exclusive coordinator ownership, semantic run/effect identity, reservations, messages, exact worker identity, terminal outcomes, recovery, and disposable SQLite reconstruction are behavior-tested. Unknown workers and usage remain blocked or reserved rather than inferred away.

tickets.title: Implement workspaces and execution profiles
notes: Digest-pinned isolated and explicit native plans, exact-env argv transports, PID/container identity probes, coalesced durable cancellation, continuous-identity native group escalation, output/runtime bounds, and Docker --rm log capture are implemented. Authenticated start, resume, and cancellation runs observed UID 65532, /workspace cwd, only the workspace and dedicated vendor-profile mounts, no Docker socket, host home, control storage, journal, or publisher credentials/environment, durable revocation before exactly one stop, and confirmed container absence. The owner-approved inner-sandbox override remained Docker-only, hardened-plan-bound, and disabled by default.

tickets.title: Implement the Codex adapter and local delivery loop
notes: The adapter and coordinator-owned single-worker path bind exact environment, cwd, model, current packet, durable source session, source factory/product/repository/workspace/provider scope, worker identity, events, final result, usage, and reservation disposition. Live authenticated evidence now proves a bounded fixture edit plus provider/local tests, exact-session same-scope resume without --last plus a second edit/test, explicit durable cancellation of a started long command, truthful interrupted_uncertain provider cancellation, confirmed container exit, unchanged cancellation workspace state, and succeeded/succeeded/cancelled projection recovery. Earlier failed attempts remain retained and demonstrate that terminal provider events cannot invent a workspace effect.

tickets.title: Implement controller-owned action admission
notes: Controller-minted per-run HMAC capabilities bind immutable scope, expected revisions, and current authority epoch. Durable cross-controller claims, restart-safe private verifier storage, effect-boundary revalidation, nonce/idempotency handling, and malformed/forged/stale/revoked denial are behavior-tested. No remote publication executor is present.

tickets.title: Implement the Claude adapter
notes: Claude transport, exact prompt authorization, explicit resume, native lifecycle, outcome normalization, and common delivery integration pass deterministic coverage. Corrected live start and exact-session resume completed; complete artifact text remained in the durable provider event while the diagnostic final summary stayed bounded.

tickets.title: Implement the Cursor adapter
notes: Cursor ACP transport, exact prompt authorization, request and notification handling, explicit session load, and confirmed process-group exit pass deterministic coverage. Unknown or mismatched initial identities quarantine without blind signaling. Corrected live implementation, executable verification, and exact-session load completed.

tickets.title: Implement team delegation and handoffs
notes: Bounded durable delegation, ownership, per-workstream allocation, exact-schema portable result evidence, artifact transfer, restart recovery, concurrent admission, and orphaned-admission repair pass deterministic coverage. The corrected live coordinator recovered handoffs across restart without duplication.

tickets.title: Prove role portability and provider substitution
notes: The corrected Claude to Cursor to Codex chain preserved the initial CHANGES REQUIRED review, recovered the complete Claude plan from the exact durable provider event, and reused the unchanged Cursor artifacts without rerunning either provider. A fresh Codex session accepted the exact plan, counter and verifier digests, and pre/post-review verification printed verification passed.

tickets.title: Implement GitHub integration
notes: Controller-owned gh operations reconcile provider effects and retain human merge authority.

tickets.title: Implement optional Jira integration
notes: Configured transitions fail visibly; explicit links preserve unsupported hierarchy.

tickets.title: Implement evidence-based progression
notes: Review and CI evidence is exact-head-bound; human merge authority is unchanged.

tickets.title: Implement deployment and maintenance entry
notes: Actual local deploy/smoke subprocesses and one durable smoke follow-up passed.

tickets.title: Build the Console shell and read views
notes: The built React/Vite Console reads the redacted live coordinator projection across Overview, Work, Run detail, and Factory views. Shared product/pod filters, a collapsible factory hierarchy, explicit dependency edges, stale-state disclosure, and accessible empty states were exercised in the local browser.

tickets.title: Add owner actions and conversation controls
notes: Owner commands are origin/token checked, durable, serialized, and replay-safe. Start returns after admission while provider work continues; next-turn messages, exact-session resume, identity-checked native/container cancellation, admission pause, record links, and bounded Cursor question/permission/plan responses remain available without browser-supplied authority or provider configuration.

tickets.title: Implement Factory GM operation

owner.role: Factory GM specialist and phase implementer-orchestrator

notes: The bounded event-driven GM observes durable provider outcomes, deduplicates exact source events across restart, opens repeated-handoff findings only after the second failure, and invokes one dynamic provider diagnosis through an owner-approved intent template. It rejects privileged product/merge/policy recommendations and leaves factory improvements approval-required.

tickets.title: Add resource and attention visibility

owner.role: Console UI specialist and phase implementer-orchestrator

notes: Factory visibility keeps reported usage, reservations, unavailable telemetry, queue age, GM findings, owner-once attention, and approval-required improvements distinct. Browser QA exercised the shared scope filter, resource view, provider response, SSE refresh, and admission pause with no console errors.

tickets.title: Exercise recovery boundaries
notes: Interrupted and uncertain work is reconstructed from the append-only journal, blocks fresh admission after restore, and requires an explicit evidence-bearing disposition before resolution.

tickets.title: Complete local service protection
notes: Loopback origin and command-token checks remain fail-closed, crafted static paths cannot escape by traversal or symlink, and startup recovers coordinator state before listening.

tickets.title: Implement backup and compatible updates
notes: Offline backups are complete, digest-verified, projection- and credential-excluding snapshots; restore targets a new root, rebinds owner configuration, preserves historical journal bytes, and update activation is approval-digest-bound and atomic.

tickets.title: Package the public kit
notes: The public tarball includes the maintenance APIs, operator guides, compatibility boundary, examples, frozen comparison materials, and a clean-consumer smoke that executes the installed backup, restore, and managed-release paths.

tickets.title: Conduct cold-start onboarding
notes: Three fresh temporary factories preserved the observed path: the first exposed missing product assembly, the second produced a behaviorally correct but scope-invalid product, and the single manager-authorized bounded rerun passed restart but used a hand-written dependency compatibility package after the genuine offline install failed. Its substituted harness reported pass, while a genuine-Playwright rerun failed delete-after-restart; absence of all outside-path reads was also not proved.

The trusted Node 24/Chromium envelope reproduces the unchanged frozen baseline. A fresh dedicated vendor login and one directly authorized isolated run then passed public provisioning, replay, genuine product-local Playwright acceptance, and an independent credential-free rerun, but stopped at the required final commit because the repository lacked local Git identity. Two npm-internal bin symlinks also prevented the literal complete-tree no-link criterion. Commit 9f0cdba repairs the Git prerequisite.

One later owner-authorized repaired rerun passed proposal, approval, apply/replay, genuine product-local Playwright 1.63 with bin links disabled, final commits, clean complete-tree link checks, retained configuration, and both worker and independent frozen browser acceptance. A runtime-only continuation then completed the narrow SQLite observation but found that public Console preparation required a native non-strict-spending work item and could not prepare the approved isolated factory. Commit 5784f41 adds explicit approval-bound projection-only preparation with no provider/work/GM authority and a real loopback hierarchy test. F7-01 remains blocked pending fresh-agent validation on that repaired public revision.

evidence.label: Approval-bound product import and Console preparation
Isolated cold-start attempt and exact blocker

Console continuation blocker and projection-only repair

tickets.title: Verify supported host and stack paths
notes: macOS package verification passed. Linux arm64 package gate passes 313 tests / 39 files, typecheck, builds and packed CLI after explicit cache preparation, retaining the updater's offline policy. Network-disabled Python 3.12 and Node 24/Chromium containers reproduce their expected frozen baselines; the Node envelope passed after an environment-only repair assigned Chromium a writable ephemeral HOME/cache on the otherwise read-only container, and the Build Manager independently reproduced the pass from the checksum-verified archive and immutable image digest. Full Linux Node/Python factory-provider-product delivery under supported isolation and completed candidate products remain outstanding. WSL2 is explicitly unverified because unavailable, but is not an independent V1 blocker. Package and frozen starting-state checks do not complete this ticket.

evidence.label: Linux Node and Python fixture evidence

tickets.title: Run the isolated Twinzy proof
notes: The owner selected TWZ-83 for a separate-branch, local-only all-provider comparison at the exact approved base, with no Jira mutation, push, merge, deployment or staging write. The Faktori GitHub controller authentication repair passed an independent live read-only observation. Native Codex, Claude and Cursor execution is still pending direct informed approval because those host processes are not an OS filesystem-isolation boundary. No provider run was launched.

tickets.title: Run the paired comparison and finalize release evidence
notes: Frozen inputs, checksums, the committed reproducible harness envelope and the dimensional rubric were independently reverified, but no isolated Triforge comparison resource/run exists and F7-01 through F7-03 are incomplete. The available Triforge checkout documents the intended untrusted-runner/trusted-publisher boundary but does not supply an approved provider-authenticated read-only mirror or result-bundle path for this comparison. Unknown incumbent and candidate cells remain unknown; no winner or release claim is published.

tickets.title: Add structured blocker details
notes: Implemented deterministic redacted blocker details in rejection values and durable journal observations, with read-only Console projection and terminal-conflict resolution. Admission, authority, cancellation, and F7 behavior are unchanged.
Independent review findings for credential signatures and multi-child terminal resolution were remediated before candidacy.

tickets.title: Export a redacted run manifest
notes: Implemented a deterministic observation-only manifest and read-only CLI using exact object schemas, field-specific value formats, credential-signature rejection, omission reasons, and canonical SHA-256 content digests.

tickets.title: Add unified read-only preflight and remediation
notes: Implemented deterministic data-only preflight across configuration, Console, execution, resources, provider, integrations, and live-evidence sections. Public JSON assertions cannot self-certify readiness; negative observations remain fail-closed and provider conflicts are fail-dominant.

After Build Manager rejection of the first candidate, added one shared read-only installed SQLite projection inspector for CLI and Console, actual factory/configuration binding, specific missing/invalid remediation, and credential-safe caller diagnostic IDs.
